fields.label: Asking $/acre
fields.desc: Asking price divided by listed acres

fields.label: Days on market
fields.desc: Days since the listing date (long = room to negotiate)

fields.label: Listing ↔ parcel match
fields.desc: Whether the listing acreage matches this parcel or spans several parcels

fields.label: Approximate parcel area
fields.desc: No exact parcel matched this listing, so its area is a circle of the listed acreage around the listing pin

fields.label: City limits
fields.desc: Municipality if inside city limits (city tax + codes apply)

fields.label: Nearest town (drive)
fields.desc: Closest town center by drive time

fields.label: Zoning
fields.desc: Assessor zoning code (verify with planning dept.)

fields.label: Address
fields.desc: Situs address (often blank/approx. for vacant land)

fields.label: Appraised land value
fields.desc: County appraisal of land (not asking price)

fields.label: Last sale price
fields.desc: Last recorded sale price ($0 = non-market transfer)

fields.label: Greenbelt
fields.desc: Enrolled in greenbelt (ag/forest use value) – rollback taxes on development

fields.label: Structures detected
fields.desc: Building footprints (Overture/MS/Google) inside parcel – may be built since assessment

fields.label: Mean slope
fields.desc: Average slope from 3DEP LiDAR DEM (10 m)

fields.label: Buildable acres
fields.desc: Area ≤15% slope, outside flood zone & wetlands

fields.label: House-site slope
fields.desc: Slope at the chosen house site

fields.label: House-site elevation
fields.desc: Elevation at the chosen house site

fields.label: Relief within parcel
fields.desc: Max − min elevation on the parcel

fields.label: Topographic position
fields.desc: House site minus mean elevation within 500 m (+ hilltop, − hollow)

fields.label: Aspect
fields.desc: Dominant facing direction of buildable ground

fields.label: Smokies crest visible
fields.desc: Share of Smokies crest points (≥1,200 m) with line-of-sight from 6 m above the house site (bare earth – trees ignored)

fields.label: Foothills visible
fields.desc: Share of Chilhowee/foothill summits (650–1,200 m) visible

fields.label: Peaks visible
fields.desc: Number of mountain sample points visible

fields.label: Nearest visible peak
fields.desc: Distance to the closest visible mountain point

fields.label: Road noise (est.)
fields.desc: Modeled daytime road noise at the house site (screening model)

fields.label: To interstate/freeway
fields.desc: Distance to I-75 / I-140 / Pellissippi / freeway

fields.label: To TYS runway
fields.desc: Distance to McGhee Tyson runways (incl. Air National Guard jets)

fields.label: Under TYS approach
fields.desc: Within the runway approach/departure corridor (12 km)

fields.label: Drive to nearest town
fields.desc: Free-flow drive time to nearest town center

fields.label: Waterfront
fields.desc: Parcel within 30 m of a lake or river

fields.label: Drive to stroke center
fields.desc: UTMC / Fort Sanders comprehensive stroke centers

fields.label: Clinics within 6 mi
fields.desc: Urgent care / primary care locations within 10 km

fields.label: To fire station
fields.desc: Nearest fire station (response time, ISO rating)

fields.label: Sinkhole risk
fields.desc: Composite of mapped LiDAR depressions + carbonate soils

fields.label: Depressions on parcel
fields.desc: USGS-mapped closed depressions intersecting the parcel

fields.label: To nearest depression
fields.desc: House site to nearest mapped depression

fields.label: Depressions within 0.6 mi
fields.desc: Mapped depressions within 1 km of house site

fields.label: Carbonate (karst) soils
fields.desc: Soil parent material is limestone/dolomite residuum

fields.label: In FEMA flood zone
fields.desc: Share of parcel in the 1% annual-chance floodplain

fields.label: Wetlands
fields.desc: Share of parcel mapped as NWI palustrine wetland

fields.label: Septic suitability (site)
fields.desc: SSURGO septic absorption rating at house site

fields.label: Septic-suitable soils
fields.desc: Share of parcel rated Not/Somewhat limited for septic

fields.label: Septic limitations
fields.desc: Main soil limitations for a drain field

sources: For-sale listings: LandSearch.com county result pages (Blount, Loudon, Monroe), matched to parcels by listing map point

Elevation: USGS 3DEP (Tennessee QL2 LiDAR) bare-earth DEM, 10 m & 30 m
Roads, POIs, land use, buildings: Overture Maps Foundation (OpenStreetMap, Microsoft, Google, Meta)
Drive times: OSRM (OpenStreetMap road network, free-flow)
Flood: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer; Wetlands: USFWS NWI
Sinkholes: USGS SIR 2024-5134 LiDAR-derived karst depressions (TN Base Mapping Program)
Soils: USDA NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access
